title: Garden trial summary
description: An ambiguous change over time and one supported observation.
answer: After four weeks, compost plots had a median height of 18 cm. Compost may have caused taller plants, although this small trial does not establish causation.

sources.title: Garden trial report
sources.text: In a small garden trial, plots receiving compost had a median height of 18 cm after four weeks. The comparison plots had a median height of 15 cm at the same time. The report does not state whether compost caused the difference.
